acceptanceCriteria: unittest and test-unit reporters classify a raising test as the TRE-V0-110 error kind, each with a live or fixture witness that fails against the old mapping
TRE spec text names the error mapping for all three runners
body:
Reported by the test-runner lane on 2026-10-21 (claude/batch-test-runner, commit a3b8cf12a or nearby). TRE-V0-110 makes the Minitest reporter classify a raising test as an error kind. The unittest and test-unit reporters still fold their native error outcomes into UNKNOWN, so the same raising test is an error in one runner and unknown in the other two.
Expected: every runner whose native report distinguishes errors from failures maps them to the same error kind, or the spec records why a runner cannot.

title: Python unittest and Ruby test-unit reporters still map native test errors to UNKNOWN, unlike Minitest after TRE-V0-110
